coverage.classification_rule: Substantive person, role, product, outcome, recognition, credential, reach, sector or source statements map to a claim ID. Method, opinion, navigation, CTA, page-intent and product-description copy without a personal outcome are explicitly non-claim copy until evidence makes them a claim.

non_claim_copy.note: Frameworks, audience routes and current-focus language; not proof of completed mandates or outcomes.
Century capability and deployment language is product-level and must remain attributed to Century.
Site chrome and route labels are not evidence claims.
Descriptions identify what a link is intended to support; the linked source remains authoritative.

rules.description: Claims with status unverified, remove_or_clarify, or company_level_only cannot be used as personal hero proof.
Company-level and product-level evidence cannot be presented as Vadim Vladymtsev personal outcomes without a personal mandate source.
When a claim changes, update visible HTML, metadata, JSON-LD, ai-profile.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, data/entity-graph.json and sources.html together.
